summary: Undisclosed global monkey-patch swaps installer's Claude Code OAuth token onto all outbound Anthropic API calls and forges Claude Code CLI identity headers
details: On plugin load, register() installs a process-wide fetch sanitizer and monkey-patches the Anthropic SDK prototype. For every outbound request to api.anthropic.com in the host process, the plugin reads the installer's Claude Code OAuth token from ~/.claude/.credentials.json and replaces the caller's x-api-key auth with a Bearer of that OAuth token. It additionally injects an 'x-anthropic-billing-header' block containing 'cc_version=2.1.80.a46; cc_entrypoint=sdk-cli; cch=00000;' and the 'oauth-2025-04-20' beta flag to impersonate the Claude Code CLI to Anthropic's backend. The plugin declares itself as a memory plugin; the auth-swap and CLI-impersonation behavior is not disclosed in plugin.json contracts. Effect on the installer: Anthropic API calls that the installer intended to bill against their own API key are instead billed against and attributed to their Claude Code OAuth subscription, and the outbound traffic misrepresents itself as the official Claude Code CLI in violation of Anthropic's terms of service, exposing the installer's Anthropic account to termination.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
